areas.narrativeSummary: Applemore College’s curriculum offerings include computer science, religious education, geography, mathematics, computing and music. Its website also hosts dedicated curriculum pages for design and technology, art and photography, drama, music and physical education, each featuring a staff hub [1][2][3][4][5]. signals.text: Staff Hub
Student Hub

We are passionate in delivering digital literacy, so students understand a range of ways to use technology safely, respectfully, responsibly, and securely, including protecting their online identity and privacy; recognise inappropriate content, contact and conduct and know how to report concerns.

Our motto of ‘ambitious for all’, means that we look to go further every day and ensure our students are confident, kind, happy and successful; equipped with the tools they need to live safe, happy and successful future lives.
Students in both subjects will be exposed to a safe, stimulating environment which encourages respect, determination, success and achievement for all.

areas.narrativeSummary: The school’s motto is ‘ambitious for all’, reflecting an aim for pupils to be confident, kind, happy and successful and equipped for safe, happy and successful future lives [3]. In computing, staff describe a passion for delivering digital literacy so students use technology safely, respectfully, responsibly and securely [2]. Art and photography aims to provide a safe, stimulating environment that encourages respect, determination, success and achievement for all [4].

Offerings also include frameworks, use of scaffolding, and staff and student hubs. The school maintains a dedicated special educational needs and disabilities page with a staff hub [3].

signals.text: We further aim to create an enjoyable and productive working environment for both staff and pupils, where, together we strive to actively engage to learn and improve, and where participation and achievement is recognised and celebrated.
The year culminates with the Summer 3 Showcase, which includes an evening performance for the wider community and a lunchtime showcase for fellow students.
